description: Configure workspace extension recommendations for team collaboration. Create the file `.vscode/extensions.json` in the workspace root (/home/ga/workspace/team_project/) with a JSON object containing a 'recommendations' array. Include at least 3 extension IDs in the format 'publisher.extension-name'. Recommended extensions for this Python + JavaScript project include: 'ms-python.python' (Python language support), 'ms-python.black-formatter' (Python formatter), 'ms-python.pylint' (Python linter), 'dbaeumer.vscode-eslint' (JavaScript linter), 'esbenp.prettier-vscode' (JavaScript/JSON formatter), 'eamodio.gitlens' (Git integration). The file must be valid JSON with proper syntax. Example structure: {"recommendations": ["ms-python.python", "dbaeumer.vscode-eslint", "esbenp.prettier-vscode"]}
